intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ (Mockito / StepVerifier where reactive) tests for EventRevision, asserting only against ast_hints. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. Immutable append-only record EventRevision(UUID recordId, int revisionNumber, RevisionReason reason, String deviceId, TelemetrySample.MetricType metricType, double value, Instant deviceTimestamp, Instant ingressTimestamp, TelemetrySample.ValidationStatus validationStatus, Instant recordedAt) with nested enum RevisionReason{ORIGINAL,CORRECTION,BACKFILL}. Invariants: revisionNumber >=1; ORIGINAL only with revision 1; (recordId, revisionNumber) unique; history is never altered, corrections append a new revision. original builds revision 1 from a sample; next builds revisionNumber+1 from this revision's recordId and the new sample with the given reason.

methods.signature: static EventRevision original(TelemetrySample sample, Instant recordedAt)
EventRevision next(TelemetrySample sample, EventRevision.RevisionReason reason, Instant recordedAt)
